_meta.note: Rush 0749 brief: Ollivant's own issues page is no longer silent on guns (July card said silent). Filed by Max as the write-path test. Score unchanged: reciprocity + no purchase permit is not constitutional carry.

douglas-ollivant@VA.notes_append: rush 2026-10-07: Campaign issues page 'Defending the Second Amendment' now states positions on reciprocity and purchase permits (campaign statements, not floor votes). The July note that his page is silent on guns is stale.

0.note: Checked 2026-10-07; page supports reciprocity, not permitless carry, so the constitutional-carry question stays open: "I support national concealed carry reciprocity so that law-abiding gun owners are not treated as criminals when they cross a state line."

4.note: Campaign issues page, Defending the Second Amendment: "I oppose any scheme that requires a government-issued permit just to purchase a firearm. That is a poll tax on a constitutional right and has no place in a free society."
